principle: Use train/calibration images ONLY — never STANDARD500 GT eval set (avoid evaluation leakage). Calibration is image-level encoder input statistics; no masks/boxes used.
source_dataset: COCO 2017 val2017 (5000 images) — ALREADY on device
source_dataset_rationale: Module C frozen-baseline protocol uses val2017 for the encoder input distribution that deployment sees. train2017 is NOT present on Jetson (only val2017.zip); pulling 19GB train2017 needs user action and gives marginal calibration benefit for an encoder already trained on train2017. val2017 is a valid, present, in-distribution source for PTQ activation statistics.
primary_rationale: 512 balances coverage vs calibration wall-time; common TRT rule-of-thumb 500-1000 batches; leaves headroom to bump to 1024 if C1 INT8 quality is borderline
sampling: deterministic random (numpy default_rng(seed).choice of val2017 jpg list)
stratification: NONE — calibration is image-level encoder-input statistics, not category/size metrics; complex stratification would expand scope without PTQ benefit
output: image paths + per-image SHA256 + sample count + seed written to calibration_manifest.json
